## Step lengths by the month of the year


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
bin_width <- 0.5  # hours

bin_means <- pig_all_steps %>%
  mutate(bin = floor(hour / bin_width) * bin_width + bin_width / 2) %>%
  group_by(bin, month) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_sl = mean(sl_, na.rm = TRUE),
    se      = sd(sl_, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(sl_))),
    q25     = quantile(sl_, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q50     = quantile(sl_, probs = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75     = quantile(sl_, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    n       = sum(!is.na(sl_)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

pig_all_steps %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = hour, y = sl_, 
             colour = as.factor(month), fill = as.factor(month))) +
  
  # geom_point(alpha = 0.01) +
  
  # interquartile range as a ribbon
  geom_ribbon(data = bin_means, inherit.aes = FALSE,
              aes(x = bin, ymin = q25, ymax = q75, 
                  fill = as.factor(month)),
              alpha = 0.15, colour = alpha("black", 0.75), linewidth = 0.1) +

  # median
  geom_line(data = bin_means, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(x = bin, y = q50, colour = as.factor(month))) +
  geom_point(data = bin_means, inherit.aes = FALSE,
             aes(x = bin, y = q50, colour = as.factor(month)), size = 1) +
  
  scale_y_continuous("Step length (m)") +
  scale_x_continuous("Hour of the day", breaks = seq(0, 24, by = 2)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 300)) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d("Month") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d("Month") +
  labs(title = "Distance between GPS locations across the hours of the day",
       subtitle = "Interquartile range (25th to 75th percentile) of step lengths") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

## Daily distance travelled


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
start_date <- min(pig_all_steps$date)
bin_width <- 3 # days

# daily distance travelled for each pig
daily_distance_id <- pig_all_steps %>%
  group_by(name, date) %>%
  summarise(
    sum_sl = sum(sl_, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# get the rolling mean of the daily distance travelled for each pig
daily_distance_id_rolling_mean <- daily_distance_id %>%
  mutate(
    bin_num  = as.numeric(date - start_date) %/% bin_width,
    date_bin = start_date + bin_num * bin_width + (bin_width-1)/2      # +2 = bin midpoint (5 days: 0-4)
  ) %>%
  group_by(name, date_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    id_sum_sl = mean(sum_sl, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = quantile(sum_sl, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q50 = quantile(sum_sl, probs = 0.5,  na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(sum_sl, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    n   = sum(!is.na(sum_sl)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# average daily distance travelled across all pigs
daily_distance_all <- daily_distance_id_rolling_mean %>%
  group_by(date_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_sum_sl = mean(id_sum_sl, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = quantile(id_sum_sl, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q50 = quantile(id_sum_sl, probs = 0.5,  na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(id_sum_sl, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    n   = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```
:::

# Weather variables

Click on the tabs below to view how the pig's daily movement varied for different weather variables. Here we are looking at how the the step lengths (which is the distance between GPS locations) varied across the hours of the day and the day fraction (where 0 = sunrise and 1 = sunset) for different weather conditions.

## Create bins for the weather variables


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pig_all_steps <- pig_all_steps %>% 
  mutate(
    max_temp_bin = cut(max_temp,
                       breaks = c(-Inf, seq(30, 38, by = 2), Inf),
                       labels = c("<30", "30–32", "32–34", "34–36", "36–38", ">38"),
                       include.lowest = TRUE,
                       right = FALSE),
    min_temp_bin = cut(min_temp,
                       breaks = c(-Inf, seq(16, 26, by = 2), Inf),
                       labels = c("<16", "16–18", "18–20", "20–22", "22–24", "24–26", ">26"),
                       include.lowest = TRUE,
                       right = FALSE),
    rainfall_bin = cut(rainfall,
                       breaks = c(0, 1, 5, 10, 20, 40, Inf),
                       labels = c("0–1", "1–5", "5–10", "10–20", "20–40", ">40"),
                       include.lowest = TRUE,
                       right = TRUE),
    solar_exp_bin = cut(solar_exp,
                       breaks = c(-Inf, 10, 15, 20, 25, Inf),
                       labels = c("<10", "10–15", "15–20", "20–25", ">25"),
                       include.lowest = TRUE,
```

```{.r .cell-code}
for (veg_col in veg_cols) {

  veg_label <- gsub("_", " ", sub("^veg_", "", veg_col)) %>%
    stringr::str_to_sentence()

  bin_summary <- pig_all_steps %>%
    group_by(day_frac_bin, month) %>%

      half   = z * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z^2 / (4 * n^2)) / (1 + z^2 / n),
      lower  = pmax(0, centre - half),
      upper  = pmin(1, centre + half)
    )

                  colour = as.factor(month), fill = as.factor(month))) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                alpha = 0.25, colour = alpha("black", 0.75), linewidth = 0.15) +

    geom_point(aes(y = p), size = 1) +
```
